what: The correct Mamba2 SSM geometry for the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B blob at F:\models\nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b.gguf, derived from the file and verified self-consistent.

ssm_in_projection_layout.cross_check: The existing NemotronHMamba2Step.hpp assumes z = I, xBC = I + inner where I is the inner size, then B = xBC + I and C = xBC + I + GS. That is NOT this layout. In this blob x occupies its own inner-sized region at offset inner, not the start of xBC. Applying the existing offsets here would silently read B from x territory and dt from the wrong place.

conv1d_layout.cross_check: convDim is not an independent parameter here. It equals inner + 2*groupState.

why_this_matters: This is the geometry any Nemotron-H implementation must use for this blob. The untracked src/deep2 NemotronHGeometry.hpp encodes a different geometry (heads 96, headDim 80, inner 7680, convDim 9728, inRows 17504) whose gate fails against this file, so it cannot be adapted by changing a constant or two. The ssm_in projection offsets differ structurally, not just in size.
not_claimed: No tensor values were evaluated. Only dimensions and metadata were read.
This certifies the geometry, not any kernel. A correct Mamba2 step still has to be written and verified against a reference for this layout.
